shortDescription.text: It checks, but doesn't send the work back

fullDescription.text: A check reports a problem, but nothing returns the work to be fixed.

help.text: A check only helps the agent if its result comes back as work. Make the check block, or route what it finds back as tasks.
help.markdown:
A check reports a problem, but nothing returns the work to be fixed.

**Why it matters:** A check only helps the agent if its result comes back as work.

**What to do:** Make the check block, or route what it finds back as tasks.

shortDescription.text: Make clear which words count as a yes

fullDescription.text: A checkpoint gives example words for approving, and the agent can end up repeating them as if they were required.

help.text: People start wondering whether their approval counts, and phrase their answers to fit a rule they can't see. What would change: the checkpoint says any clear yes counts, or it asks with buttons so there is nothing to phrase.

shortDescription.text: A skill the model may misuse

fullDescription.text: A skill has a problem in its own text: no description, no steps, a name that doesn't match its folder, or rules that contradict.

help.text: The model picks skills by their description and follows their steps; a vague or broken one fires wrongly or does the wrong thing. Fix the skill's text as the message says.
